description: Structured lookup of prassi documents by their extremes, without the text (replaces the legacy query_prassi). Filters, all optional and combined with AND: tipo (circolare, risoluzione, provvedimento, interpello; exact, case-insensitive), numero (exact text, e.g. "10" or "6/E" as stored), anno, data_from and data_to (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive), ente (substring), fonte (ade-portale or doctrib). sort (tipo, anno, numero, data; default tipo) with desc (default false); a missing value is always last. limit (1..50, default 20) and offset page the result; every row carries total, the size of the filtered set. Rows: id, ente, tipo, numero, anno, data, oggetto (first 300 characters), source_url, fonte, total. A call without any parameter lists the first page of the corpus. Read a document with it-prassi_doc. Example: {"tipo": "circolare", "anno": 2025, "sort": "numero", "desc": true, "limit": 10}.
